steps.sql: DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'{"pad":['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65535)+N'0],"v":[]}'; DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.v',JSON_QUERY(N'[1]')); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes; SELECT RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),40) AS tail;

DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'{"pad":['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65535)+N'0],"v":[]}'; CREATE TABLE jw(j json); INSERT jw VALUES(CAST(@s AS json)); SELECT DATALENGTH(j) AS bytes FROM jw; UPDATE jw SET j=JSON_MODIFY(j,'$.v',JSON_QUERY(N'[1]')); SELECT DATALENGTH(j) AS bytes FROM jw; SELECT RIGHT(CAST(j AS nvarchar(max)),40) AS tail FROM jw;
